comment: Starting archetypes pre-seed attribute spreads and a signature thought, like DE's Thinker/Sensitive/Physical — but each is a wound, not a class.

archetypes.name: The Clerk Who Counted
archetypes.blurb: You were good with ledgers and bad with people. The mind is a fortress; the heart is a rumour. They say you noticed something in the numbers you shouldn't have.

archetypes.name: The Open Wound
archetypes.blurb: You feel everything, all the time, whether or not you're invited to. It has cost you a marriage, a posting, and most of your sleep. People tell you the truth. You wish they wouldn't.

archetypes.name: The Old Dog
archetypes.blurb: Twenty years on the worst streets in Hollowreach taught your body things your mind forgot. You hit first, you stand in doorways, and you have never once filled out a form correctly. Something finally broke.

archetypes.name: The Hollow Man
archetypes.blurb: You woke on the quay with no name and no past, only a notebook in your own hand. Build yourself from nothing. (Free point allocation.)
